title: Brand pack
description: One brand: names and copy, logo files, colours, font pair and product categories. See docs/11-white-label.md.

id.description: Same as the folder name. Select it with NEXT_PUBLIC_BRAND.

name.description: Brand name shown everywhere (header, titles, emails).

tagline.description: Slogan in one line (page titles, sign-in panel).

taglineLines.description: The slogan as two lines: setup, then the large gold punchline (footer).

descriptor.description: Short line under the finale on the home page.

sideline.description: Words printed on the side of the 3D box.

description.description: One or two sentences: what you sell and how it works (footer, search engines).

legalEntity.description: Company name in the copyright line.

fonts.description: inscription = Cinzel + Jost (engraved capitals), editorial = Playfair Display + Source Sans 3, modern = Sora + Manrope.

mark.description: Logo symbol on a transparent background (webp or png), in this folder.

markWidth.description: Pixel width of the mark file.

markHeight.description: Pixel height of the mark file.

lockup.description: Optional full logo (symbol + name) for the footer. Falls back to the mark.

silhouette.description: Optional one-colour outline of the mark as an SVG path, for dark ink on light box finishes. Without it the mark's shape is used as a mask.

categories.description: Product categories of this niche, in display order. 'credit' and 'mixed' are reserved.

drawing.description: Line drawing shown when a product has no photo.

showcase.description: Show this category's top piece on the home page.

themeColor.description: Browser toolbar colour on phones, per mode.

theme.description: CSS colour tokens. 'dark' is the base; 'light' overrides it in light mode.
